hallmarked.unique.brandts_waxed_hood.lor: Speak quietly. Wear wax. Do not drop tools.
hallmarked.unique.gales_bank_shovel.lore: Foreman Gale banked every kiln with it rather than double the draught.
hallmarked.unique.marshs_field_boots.lor: She walked the island edges in these and never once looked down.
hallmarked.unique.penitents_lamp.lore: He kept a light on for anyone who came asking. You came asking.
